title: Ensure a minimum number of administrators are set for the repository
titleZh: 每个仓库至少 2 名管理员
description: A repository with one administrator is a repository whose settings become unmaintainable the moment that person is unavailable — and whose branch protections nobody else can restore.
remediation: Repository settings -> Repository permissions: grant "Admin" to at least one more trusted maintainer, or grant "Admin" at Project settings -> Project permissions so a group covers all repositories in the project. Adjust the minimum with thresholds.minRepositoryAdmins in scm-bench's config.
remediationZh: 仓库设置 -> Repository permissions：为至少一位可信维护者授予「Admin」；也可在 项目设置 -> Project permissions 授予组级 Admin，一次覆盖项目内全部仓库。最小值可通过 scm-bench 配置项 thresholds.minRepositoryAdmins 调整。
